slice_preflight.method: Exact decimal-centered triangle-plane intersection; endpoint weld tolerance 1e-7 mm; Shapely closed polygons with odd-even rings; not extrusion toolpaths

overhang_preflight.criterion: down-facing triangles >45 degrees from vertical, excluding build-plate bottom

practical_features.display_size_note: Model millimeters only; main length 240 mm is a display choice, not a surveyed scale.
limitations: No physical test print or slicer extrusion toolpath verification.
Overhangs below the top floor, canopy, landings and steps require support assessment.
Thin mullions and color regions may require larger display scale, resin or multi-material feature tuning.
Solid opaque glass and filled rooms are exterior-model simplifications, not real interiors.
Numerical mesh/slice checks do not guarantee adhesion, strength or support-free printing.
Supports need assessment under the top-floor overhangs, canopy, exterior stairs and landings.
Opaque glass panels and trim have actual face assignments, not photographic textures. Fine frames, bars and rails are thickened and may require enlargement or resin.

Complete bounded three-storey B exterior and own platform; no neighboring blocks, basement interior, exact west elevation, individual rooflight profiles, site survey or structural simulation. No measured scale claim.
